appContext.summary: BOUNTY is a live, real-world city treasure hunt. Players buy a ticket to a live event in their city, follow real-time clues, navigate the hunt zone on a map, and the first hunter to find the target wins the cash prize pool. Dark, minimal, amber-accented competitive design.

theme.style: Nocturnal city energy in near-black charcoal with molten amber glows, like streetlights and signal flares cutting through a midnight urban fog. The mood is competitive, tense and minimal. Fine film grain, soft volumetric haze and sharp warm rim light create depth without clutter. Backgrounds stay dark and restrained so the amber accents feel like a live, urgent pulse.
